name: flit-boilerplate
description: FLIT Boilerplate — Monorepo .NET 10 + Python ML + Next.js 16 (post ADR-0014 consolidación stack 2026-05-27)

scripts.install:all: pnpm run install:js && pnpm run install:dotnet
scripts.install:all:with-python: pnpm run install:js && pnpm run install:dotnet && pnpm run install:python
scripts.build:python: uv --directory services/python-ml run python -m compileall app -q
scripts.build: pnpm run build:js && pnpm run build:core-api
scripts.dev:core-api: dotnet watch --project services/core-api/src/Flit.Api run --launch-profile http --urls http://localhost:4003
scripts.dev:gateway: dotnet watch --project services/core-api/src/Flit.Gateway run --launch-profile http --urls http://localhost:4002
scripts.dev:python: uv --directory services/python-ml run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 4012 --log-level info
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n frontend,core-api,gateway -c green,magenta,cyan "pnpm run dev:frontend" "pnpm run dev:core-api" "pnpm run dev:gateway"
scripts.dev:with-python: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n frontend,core-api,gateway,python -c green,magenta,cyan,yellow "pnpm run dev:frontend" "pnpm run dev:core-api" "pnpm run dev:gateway" "pnpm run dev:python"
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n frontend,core-api,gateway -c green,magenta,cyan "pnpm run start:frontend" "pnpm run start:core-api" "pnpm run start:gateway"
scripts.start:with-python: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n frontend,core-api,gateway,python -c green,magenta,cyan,yellow "pnpm run start:frontend" "pnpm run start:core-api" "pnpm run start:gateway" "pnpm run start:python"
scripts.test: pnpm run test:js && pnpm run test:core-api
scripts.test:with-python: pnpm run test:js && pnpm run test:core-api && pnpm run test:python
scripts.test:coverage: concurrently -n frontend,core-api,python -c green,magenta,yellow "pnpm --filter @flit/frontend test:coverage" "dotnet test services/core-api/Flit.slnx --collect:'XPlat Code Coverage'" "uv --directory services/python-ml run pytest --cov=app"
scripts.lint:python: uv --directory services/python-ml run ruff check app tests
scripts.lint:with-python: pnpm run lint:js && pnpm run lint:python
scripts.lint:fix: pnpm --filter @flit/frontend lint:fix && uv --directory services/python-ml run ruff check --fix app tests && dotnet format services/core-api/Flit.slnx
scripts.fix:frontend: pnpm run lint:fix:frontend && pnpm run format:write:frontend
scripts.fix:all:fullstack: pnpm run lint:fix && pnpm run format
scripts.format: pnpm --filter @flit/frontend format && uv --directory services/python-ml run ruff format app tests && dotnet format services/core-api/Flit.slnx
scripts._comment_migrate_rule: core-api es DUEÑO de TODAS las migraciones (ADR-0014).
scripts.migrate:core-api: dotnet ef database update --project services/core-api/src/Flit.Infrastructure --startup-project services/core-api/src/Flit.Api
scripts._comment_docker_rule: Para dev local diario usa 'docker:up:infra' (solo dependencias) + 'pnpm dev'. El stack completo es para validar prod-like.
scripts.docker:up:infra: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d postgres redis rabbitmq minio minio-init mailhog
scripts.docker:up:obs: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d otel-collector prometheus loki tempo grafana
scripts.docker:reset:infra: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml down -v postgres redis rabbitmq minio
scripts.clean: pnpm -r --if-present exec rm -rf dist .next && dotnet clean services/core-api/Flit.slnx
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test
